title: Data Quality Issue Resolution
description: Resolution of record-quality problems: missing/invalid coordinates, impossible dates, incomplete records.

steps.title: List the specific issues
steps.guidance: Review each data-quality issue on the project: which field, what is wrong, and its severity.

steps.title: Obtain correct values
steps.guidance: Request corrected values from the implementing agency or district records (correct dates, actual site coordinates).

steps.title: Record the correction outcome
steps.guidance: Record what was corrected and note that AI signals should be re-evaluated on the corrected data in the next pipeline run.
